resumeText:

- Tested every call flow end to end in UAT before each release.

Associate Developer, Sahyadri Contact Solutions, Pune (2018 - 2020)

Amazon Connect, Python, Avaya, Salesforce, Postman

BE Electronics and Telecommunication, Pune University, 2018
